newsitem.title: USA: Metricom, Brooklyn Union in network venture.
newsitem.headline: Metricom, Brooklyn Union in network venture.

text.p: Metricom Inc, and Brooklyn Union Gas Co's KeySpan energy-marketing companies, said Wednesday they had signed a memorandum of understanding to invest in a joint-venture company to market Metricom's Ricochet wireless network service in metropolitan areas in 16 Midwest and Northeastern states.

The joint-venture company, Keyspan-Metricom, will invest in building the infrastructure for the Ricochet wireless modem and Internet service in metropolitan areas including New York City, Detroit, Philadelphia, Chicago and Boston.

The potential deployment will cover approximately 45 million people and could result in an investment of $300 million. Metricom and KeySpan will invest as much as $25 million each in the first two years.

"Metricom's partnership with KeySpan is a bold move in helping us to more quickly provide affordable, convenient, wireless Internet and e-mail access to computer users in major metropolitan areas," said Robert P. Dilworth, Metricom president and CEO. "We believe this is a critical time to set the standard for wireless communications and information tools that the Internet community is demanding, and (the venture) will enable us to take advantage of that."
